purpose: Machine-readable recovery scenarios required before 3.2 architecture admission.

scenarios.name: W06-unavailable
scenarios.expected: request path remains bounded and uses defined stale/degraded behavior

scenarios.name: stale-placement
scenarios.expected: stale generation cannot mutate newer authoritative state

scenarios.name: partial-write
scenarios.expected: durable write contract fails closed without false publish success

scenarios.name: migration-cutover-failure
scenarios.expected: cutover is reversible or enters explicit recovery state

scenarios.name: control-state-corruption
scenarios.expected: recovery uses authoritative backup/LKG path without circular bootstrap

scenarios.name: reconciler-oscillation
scenarios.expected: convergence guard detects and stops oscillation
